contract: Higher-package candidates enter first. Before repository sorting, remove every base candidate whose exact concatenated id+version string occurs in the higher candidates; the concatenation has no delimiter.
Build markets by splitting actual PLUGIN_MARKET on comma and omitting empty strings. This function does not additionally trim/normalize/case-fold repository strings.

Repository rank: exact configured online repository uses its first markets.index position; other nonlocal/absent repositories use len(markets); local:// repositories use len(markets)+1. Python sorting is stable within a rank.

First dedup is keyed by exact concatenated id+version, not a tuple and not ID alone. First candidate in ranked order wins, except explicit existing-local/current-online replacement. Cross-ID concatenation collisions therefore suppress a legal candidate.

Sort the deduplicated values again by repository rank. Second dictionary is keyed by ID. Replace its value only when actual StringUtils.compare_version(candidate.version, ">", previous.version) returns true, or exact version strings match and previous is local while candidate is online.

Replacing a dictionary value does not move the ID insertion position. Returned order is the first encounter of each surviving ID in the second ranked pass, not a final resort by selected version/repository.

For valid repository string values, markets.index is membership-guarded and uses a local immutable list; unlisted and repeated configured URLs have deterministic ranks. The six executed cases do not claim arbitrary malformed-object exception equivalence.
scope: Six observed original full-component selection cases from the new 20261030 independent audit, not Go-derived expected output.
